title: RAW UNREVIEWED: source-calibrated attached-mark augmentation under one lexical spelling channel
summary: Constrain a mixed writing hypothesis through actual Reg.gr.181 attached tau/mu supplementation and whole-word kai, rather than a free syllable dictionary. Exact mark attachment and insertion gaps must be measured on complete source words, then one position-preserving channel must serve prose and isolated labels.

design.hypothesis: A small class of written modifiers augments an otherwise spelled carrier by inserting a fixed latent letter/string at a source-calibrated gap. Ordinary carriers and declared whole-word notes share a finite spelling channel. Complete labels and prose words obey the same rule; marks do not dispatch owner-dependent English actions or change value by topic. Greek is the external comparator, not the selected target language.

Table284r is exact canvasp0599; medical passage265v isp0562. Allen1890 JHS11,286–293 andplateX were completely read. owned_concrete_constraints: Tau dots supply tau inside otherwise written words such as tois/autos in passageI; their placement may shift to avoid iota dots, so attachment/insertion offset needs word-level annotation.
Two dots below the following carrier supply mu. Relative attachment matters; total dot count is inadequate.

A whole-word kai note occurs in the table and complete sourceIV sentence. The11-word honey/brief-boil/filter/give-to-drink sentence mixes recognizable letters, shorthand and a partly mixed word; classes overlap.

The table has unused signs, two ek forms, a two-word hyper tas entry, possible mistakes and another hands apo addition. Some words redundantly write letters already supplied by a note. These are fixed source alternatives to retain, not general target escape licenses.

For a later authorized target nomination, independently measure a position-preserving target primitive inventory on already owned loci and pay any whole residual. SIA001 f31r.7/f50v.8 supplies actual supralinear insertion observations, but not mark identity, abbreviation, phonology or correction intent; no pixels are opened here.
A common source-to-target correspondence must remain bounded across at least one whole prose unit and an isolated label. No class or carrier gets a separate convenient word value.
design.reading_decision_consequence: Attachment determines different full lexical strings under one key; these must enter the full proposition and label lemma consistently. A movement of a mark can change the reconstructed word only through the frozen insertion law. Free world/owner renaming cannot cure an orthographic contradiction. Survivors still need meaning evidence and equivalent keys remain explicit.
design.falsifier: Reject the declared augmentation channel if one fixed source-local attachment/insertion rule cannot reconstruct the complete nonseed source sample, if supposed target augmentation has no independent physical attachment/gap evidence, or if common lexical reconstruction requires per-occurrence marks, silently redundant letters or new whole-note values. Missing observation remains UNKNOWN rather than disproving shorthand.
